name: Mexican Chicken Soup with Avocado & Tortilla Crisps

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 450°F (232°C) and place the rack in the center position.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 avocados
3 limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice the limes into a medium bowl.
Stack the tortillas; cut in half, then cut crosswise into 1 ¼-cm-wide strips and transfer to a baking sheet.
Drizzle the tortilla strips with olive oil and season with salt; toss to coat then spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place the tortilla strips in the oven and bake until golden brown and crispy, 6 to 8 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven and transfer to a paper towel lined plate.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, halve the breasts horizontally to form thin fillets. Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken to the skillet; cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate to cool. Cook in batches if necessary.
While the chicken cooks, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion (cut into 6-mm pieces).
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper to the onion; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the broth, tomatoes, and lime juice to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1419 ml (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomaotes

instructions.primary_message: Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces and add to the soup immediately.
Halve the avocados lengthwise and twist the halves to separate, then remove the pit with a knife or spoon; scoop out and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Stir the cilantro into the soup.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls, then top with the avocado and tortilla crisps. Enjoy!
